subject: Mutual Action Plan: Integration delivery cadence & owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@cardiowell.com>, eng-team@cardiowell.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Integration delivery cadence & owners

Hi Alice / CardioWell team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. As promised, attached is a first pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the integration delivery milestones for the SDK + streaming + tool-calling work we discussed. This is deliberately prescriptive so we can align on owners and unblock procurement/engineering work.

Top-level summary (proposed):
- Target commercial close: 2027-06-21 (moveable with written agreement)
- Integration target handoff to CardioWell staging: 2027-07-12
- Pilot window (integration + validation): 2027-07-13 to 2027-07-27

Key MAP milestones (owner — target date):
1) MAP sign-off (Sales / Procurement) — Alice Wong / CardioWell & Marissa Cole — 2027-06-07
2) Procurement + PO issued — procurement@cardiowell.com — 2027-06-14
3) SDK access + example code drop — Redwood SDK team (Priyom Das) — 2027-06-21
4) Streaming + KV cache config for low-latency paths — Redwood infra (Dev Patel) + CardioWell Eng — 2027-06-28
5) Tool-calling contract and function schema review — Product & CardioWell PM — 2027-07-05
6) Structured outputs & validation harness delivery — Redwood QE (Ben Carter) — 2027-07-10

Dependencies / risks:
- CardioWell to confirm QPS and peak latency SLOs by 2027-06-04 (affects streaming config)
- SOC2 evidence / security questionnaire for Private deployment if required — see attached template
- Contract redlines: we expect a standard SOW + Data Processing Addendum; legal review may add 5–7 business days

Ask / next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP (CW_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and call out any missing milestones or wrong owner assignments by EOD 2027-06-04.
2) Confirm procurement contact and expected PO cadence so we can align the SDK access window.
3) Proposed follow-up: 30-minute call on 2027-06-03 10:00 AM PT to walk owners through streaming config options and to confirm QPS.

Attachments: CW_MAP_v0.3.xlsx, integration-scoping-notes.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0189

From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@cardiowell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: eng-team@cardiowell.com, procurement@cardiowell.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integration delivery cadence & owners

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Overall this looks good; a few notes from our side after an internal sync: 

1) Target close: we need to move the commercial close out by one week to 2027-06-28 to align with our procurement cycles — otherwise the dates look fine.
2) Streaming QPS: our expected peak is ~120 qps with spiky bursts to 250 qps for short windows. Latency SLO target for user-facing flows is 150–200ms P95. Can Redwood support prefix caching / KV cache optimization for that profile?
3) Tool-calling scope: we expect two external systems (claims lookup + EHR pointers) with a strict schema; we'll share sample schemas by 2027-06-02.
4) Security: attaching our filled security questionnaire; we will need SOC2 evidence and network architecture diagrams if this goes to Private deployment.

We'll take the MAP and add a small "security gating" milestone so the dates reflect the dependency. Procurement is copied — they will follow up re: PO timing.

Thanks — happy to discuss on the 6/3 slot if that still works.

Best,
Alice Wong
Head of Product Integrations
CardioWell, Inc.
alice.wong@cardiowell.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual Action Plan: Integration delivery cadence & owners

Marissa / team — quick internal engineering notes to capture before we update the MAP: 

- For 120 qps peak, we'll recommend two dedicated streaming workers with continuous batching and an autoscale buffer; primary optimization will be prefix/KV caching for user session continuity. Dev — can you validate that the requested P95 150–200ms is achievable on a 4xA10G pool with the current model family?
- Structured outputs: we'll supply a validation harness (pytest + sample prompts) and a JSON schema that CardioWell can run locally. Ben will own delivery of the harness.
- Tool-calling: needs an agreed function schema + fallback policy. Priyom to coordinate with CardioWell PMs on the function schema and error-handling semantics.

Action items (internal):
- Dev Patel: performance validation & staging run (target 2027-06-21)
- Priyom Das: SDK sample drop + tool-calling template (target 2027-06-21)
- Ben Carter: structured output harness + sample tests (target 2027-07-05)

I'll prep a short engineering appendix to attach to the next MAP revision with the perf assumptions.

- Ben
Engineering (Redwood Inference)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@cardiowell.com>, eng-team@cardiowell.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, procurement@cardiowell.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integration delivery cadence & owners — updated MAP attached

Thanks Alice — and thanks Ben for the quick appendix notes. Per Alice's ask we moved the commercial close to 2027-06-28 and added a security gating milestone (SOC2 evidence + network diagrams) ahead of any Private deployment. I attached an updated MAP (CW_MAP_v0.4.xlsx) that reflects:

- New commercial close: 2027-06-28
- "Security gating" milestone added before staging handoff (owner: CardioWell Security / Redwood Security)
- Engineering appendix stub with perf assumptions (Ben's section)
- Explicit owner assignments for SDK drop (Priyom) and staging validation (Dev)

Next steps:
1) Alice / CardioWell: please confirm MAP sign-off or provide redlines by 2027-06-07 so we can lock resources.
2) Dev / Priyom / Ben: please share the SDK sample drop and perf run plan in the shared Drive folder by 2027-06-21. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cMapDraftLink

Attachments: CW_MAP_v0.4.xlsx, CardioWell_Security_Questionnaire_Fill.pdf

If you prefer, we can do a 15-minute owner-only sync on 2027-06-04 to walk the engineering appendix before the 6/7 sign-off cutoff.

Thanks everyone — I'll wait for CardioWell's sign-off.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
